trends.raw_quote: Bedtime becomes a huge issue and leads to tantrums. I know a parent who it takes 2 hours to get their toddler to sleep.
trends.problem_description: Parents of toddlers (18mo–3.5yr) face nightly bedtime battles lasting 1–2+ hours. Common triggers: nursing-to-sleep associations, boundary testing, and sleep regressions. Parents feel guilty, exhausted, and stuck.
pain_points: No method works consistently across toddlers
trends.actionable_scope: 10-page guide with gentle sleep transition method for toddlers already dependency-trained

trends.raw_quote: It honestly blows my mind that it's 2025 and we still haven't found a solid cat litter option that checks all the boxes.

pain_points: Cat litter tracking through the house
Dust from clay litter affecting respiratory health
No clear buying guide for litter types
trends.actionable_scope: 10-page guide: cat litter type guide, best picks per situation, maintenance tips

trends.raw_quote: Backups that overflow into my basement. There's a long, nearly-level run of PVC drain pipe in the basement.
